target_api: torch.compile / class attribute mutation and instance read
expected_behavior: After assigning K.n=5, K().n must be 5, so a zero tensor plus it is 5. Preserve eager warmup and reset sequence; restore pretest class state on exit.
bug_signature: Dynamo eager-backend output is 0 although class K.n becomes 5 when K.__module__ is an external name (isolated test_bug or project-root bugs.torch_205991.test_bug). In this build UserDefinedClassVariable.get_value_for_setattr treats torch/torch.*/torch_* names as internal; importlib --rootdir=bugs instead gives torch_205991.test_bug and correct output 5. Same-file rootdir experiments explain the apparent order sensitivity. The test checks this namespace precondition after observing the call and does not rewrite __module__, skip, or accept output 5 as reproduction. Compiler mode and collection root must be recorded. See the summary for all passing and non-reproducing modes.
